title: I Built My First AI Agent With AWS AgentCore, and the Hardest Part Wasn't the AI
why_read: A first-person account of building a customer support AI agent using AWS Bedrock AgentCore, useful mainly as a beginner-level integration walkthrough.
analysis: This post describes a learner's experience wiring together many AWS services, including AgentCore Runtime, Gateway, Lambda, a knowledge base, memory, and a browser tool, to build a multi-feature customer support agent. The real insight offered is that the hardest part was managing complexity and sequencing understanding rather than the AI logic itself, a common and valid lesson in systems integration. It's a personal learning-project writeup rather than a novel technique or rigorous benchmark, so its value is mostly for readers new to AWS's agent tooling ecosystem.
